metas.name: Six Men Getting Sick
metas.description: Lynch's first film project consists of a looping animation of six people vomiting projected on to a special sculptured screen featuring twisted three-dimensional faces.

metas.name: Sailing with Bushnell Keeler
metas.description: In 1967, a young David Lynch grabbed his new Bolex 16mm camera, to film his friend and mentor Bushnell Keeler and brother Dave Keeler sailing on the Chesapeake Bay in Bush's King's Cruiser. This was David Lynch's very first film, which he prefers to call a "home movie". It depicts a man, a painter, who changed David's life forever pursuing the artist's life, which he continues to this day.

metas.name: Fictitious Anacin Commercial
metas.description: Parody of '60s Anacin commercials.

metas.name: Absurd Encounter with Fear
metas.description: A man approaches a woman in a field.

metas.name: The Alphabet
metas.description: A woman's dark and absurdist nightmare vision comprising a continuous recitation of the alphabet and bizarre living representations of each letter.

metas.name: The Grandmother
metas.description: To escape neglect and abuse from his parents, a young boy plants some strange seeds and they grow into a grandmother.

metas.name: The Amputee
metas.description: A double amputee attempts to write a letter while her nurse gets in the way.

metas.name: The Cowboy and the Frenchman
metas.description: A grizzled, hard-of-hearing cowboy, Slim, and his two friends, Dusty and Pete, capture a mysterious, well-dressed Frenchman.

metas.name: One Morning All Over the World
metas.description: An ad for an advertising company, consisting of 7-second sequence shots by 13 directors.

metas.name: Head with Hammer
metas.description: An aspect of life.

metas.name: Factory Mask
metas.description: Suddenly, in the cramped boiler room, a pressure-relief valve opens and discharges steam. Then, a certified technician approaches to perform a routine check. But, is he wearing his factory mask?

metas.name: Laura Palmer
metas.description: Against the backdrop of a silky, bubblegum-pink curtain, the abused, traumatised, and emotionally broken teenage homecoming queen, Laura Palmer, the pivotal character of Twin Peaks (1990), and Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me (1992), seems lost in thought. What does she see? What does she hear? As the ill-fated student struggles to harness lingering questions, the haunting theme of Angelo Badalamenti intensifies the elaborate mystery, and the tragedy of loss concludes with a climactic close-up of once-happy Laura Palmer.—Nick Riganas

metas.name: Out Yonder — Neighbor Boy
metas.description: Humorous short film in which David Lynch and his son Austin observe the follies of their neighbor.

metas.name: Pierre and Sonny Jim
metas.description: Life can be hard on planet Earth, especially when you're running out of air.

metas.name: Dead Mouse with Ants
metas.description: Features a dead mouse with ants on it.

metas.name: Coyote #1
metas.description: A coyote somehow finds a way to a motel room.

metas.name: Darkened Room
metas.description: Two young women find themselves in a dark room where there is a distinctly strange feeling.

metas.name: Premonitions Following an Evil Deed
metas.description: A short film about the events following a murder.

metas.name: The Pig Walks
metas.description: No one knows what has been going on behind the closed doors of the city's macabre and noisome abattoir.

metas.name: Bees
metas.description: An incessant buzzing noise catches the attention of the indefatigable American filmmaker, David Lynch, who, without delay, starts filming one of the most extraordinary defensive moves in nature: the mighty bee ball.

metas.name: Industrial Soundscape
metas.description: Music is produced by different objects in an industrial and desolate landscape.

metas.name: The Disc of Sorrow Is Installed
metas.description: The Disc of Sorrow gets installed.

metas.name: Lamp
metas.description: Short documentary of David Lynch building a lamp.

metas.name: Boat
metas.description: A journey into night.

metas.name: Intervalometer Experiments
metas.description: David Lynch experiments with time and photography in three different locations.

metas.name: Bug Crawls
metas.description: In a solemn, haunted environment, a small bug crawls over the silhouette of a house.

metas.name: Scissors
metas.description: Amid the palpable darkness of the local cinema, a film about dancing gradually transforms into a surreal experience of psychological horror, as four friends struggle to interpret the strikingly realistic and blood-curdling on-screen imagery.

metas.name: Blue Green
metas.description: Blue Green is a surreal, ambient short film capturing the mood and the lone tone of a giant industrial setting.

metas.name: Ballerina
metas.description: David Lynch turns this digital video of a ballerina into an impressionistic exercise.

metas.name: Hollyshorts Greeting
metas.description: A fun short piece that Lynch presented as his acceptance for the Hollyshorts 2008 Visionary Award.

metas.name: Twin Peaks Festival Greeting 2008
metas.description: A surreal short film that Lynch made for the 2008 Twin Peaks Festival. It only screened once and is in black and white. In this film, Lynch is speaking backwards in what looks to be a cross between the floors of Eraserhead and the Twin Peaks Red Room. Sitting next to him is a plastic doll with the face of Laura Palmer.

metas.name: Early Experiments
metas.description: A 16mm film experiment conducted in 1967 and 1968 in Philadelphia which feature small parts of the Alphabet and the Grandmother.

metas.name: Memory Film
metas.description: Experimental short created for the 7th annual Memory Marathon at London’s Serpentine Gallery, exploring the theme of memory through image and sound.

metas.name: Idem Paris
metas.description: A nearly wordless portrait of the renowned fine art printing studio in Paris, capturing the intricate process of lithography.

metas.name: Ergo-Robots
metas.description: Ergo-Robots (2015) is a short film co-directed by David Lynch and Pierre-Yves Oudeyer. It was produced in collaboration with INRIA's FLOWERS research team, which specializes in machine learning and developmental robotics.

metas.name: Fire (Pożar)
metas.description: Lynch made the animation film Pożar (Fire) in 2015 after the Polish-American composer Marek Zebrowski created a musical composition as a tribute to him. The film was included in the 2018 retrospective "Someone Is In My House".

metas.name: David Lynch's Comic-Con Message
metas.description: David Lynch shares a message on a Twin Peaks (2017) Comic-Con panel.

metas.name: Ant Head
metas.description: Ants gather and consume a head-like shape in a static, abstract composition set to experimental music.

metas.name: WHAT DID JACK DO?
metas.description: In a locked down train station, a homicide detective conducts an interview with a tormented monkey  who is suspected of murder.

metas.name: What Is David Lynch Working on Today?
metas.description: A collection of video logs that answer the question 'What Is David Lynch Working on Today?' David works on a wood sink, urinal, checking stick, microphone stand, litho signing, phone holder, pants repair, paint drawers, varnishing, mirror, the jar, balls, thinking, dowel, sculpture, wall sconce and teaching.

metas.name: The Adventures of Alan R.
metas.description: This is a 90 second short film where a severed head on a black room type patterned floor repeats a statement about "not going fishing today."

metas.name: The Story of a Small Bug
metas.description: David Lynch documents the story of a small bug.

metas.name: The Spider and the Bee
metas.description: Two deadly insects, locked in a battle to the death; the Spider (determined to devour prey) and the Bee (armored to fight back).

metas.name: The Mystery of the Seeing Hand
metas.description: David Lynch Theater Presents:  THE MYSTERY OF THE SEEING HAND

metas.name: We'll Deliver 'Em
metas.description: Two stock-footage train operators find out about David Lynch's new album with Chrystabell.

metas.name: I Have a Radio
metas.description: Two animated figures dance to the  song "I Have a Radio" by David Lynch.
